column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “A Psalm,” and “all my inward parts” is rendered “all that is within me.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִשַּׁחַת (“from the pit”) is rendered “from destruction,” and “covenant loyalty and compassions” “lovingkindness and tender mercies.”
NKJV renders the obscure עֶדְיֵךְ (“your ornament”) as “your mouth.”
Close to the Hebrew; יָרִיב (“contend”) is rendered “strive with us,” and NKJV supplies “His anger.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his covenant loyalty is strong” is rendered “So great is His mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; יִצְרֵנוּ (“our form”) is rendered “our frame.”
Close to the Hebrew; פִקֻּדָיו (“his precepts”) is rendered “His commandments.”
Close to the Hebrew; “mighty ones of strength” is rendered “Who excel in strength.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his servants who do his will” is rendered “You ministers of His, who do His pleasure.”
